description: Publicly reported waterlogging spots in Bengaluru near the ORR survey, from police reports quoted in news articles. Shown on the map for context only: three points are far too few for an accuracy score. Coordinates come from OpenStreetMap Nominatim and are approximate (about +-150 m). The Panathur railway bridge (reported 2023) is left out because it could not be located confidently.
